text: Rank calibration record provenance (from M5.03 salvage review, PR #45): main's CalibrationProtocolSupport.RankMetrics records lack provenance the unmerged branch work/umvpa-next-20261007 (RankCalibrationRecord, commit 47e14319) carried: source commit, source-lock hash, input hash, and seed-receipt checks. Recommendation: add these fields plus validation to main's record schema as a small separate change under this mote (not in #45). Rationale: these records are qualification evidence and #45's calibration_readiness.py now requires hash-bound evidence receipts, so unhashed records would be the weak link; seed-receipt checks guard stream independence, which calibration validity depends on. Formatting note: do not reformat mvpa-group/mvpa wholesale while M4.07-M4.09 work is open; format touched files only, and if a module-wide format is wanted, do it in one mechanical commit together with adding its scalafmtCheck to the CI gate.
